messages:
Sam Carter (CSM): Quick weekly check-in for Northpoint Labs' Private/VPC deployment. Posting region-by-region notes from the last 7d. TL;DR: seoul connectivity flaps, KMS rotation queued, spend +18% week-over-week due to unexpected burst in embeddings.
Alex Nguyen (Infra): Got the graphs. Seoul (ap-northeast-2) shows 99.1% uptime with 3 short tunnel drops (1-2m). Other regions stable 99.98+.
Priya Rao (Eng Oncall): Investigated the Seoul events — looks like VPN tunnel rekey failures tied to peer appliance. We retried connections automatically at 02:34 UTC and 04:12 UTC.
monitoring-bot: ALERT: vpn-tunnel-flap seoul-nw-1 — 3 events in 15h — see logs: `vpn_tunnel: flapping, peer_rekey_failed`
Sam Carter (CSM): Martin from Northpoint mentioned they saw stalled requests during the 02:34 drop. Martin, did those correlate with any KMS errors on your side?
Martin Lee (Northpoint): Yep — our app saw ~40 5xxs during that window. We also had a key rotation scheduled but it didn't complete until 03:10, so some requests retried.
Priya Rao (Eng Oncall): We saw elevated token p95 latency in seoul during 02:30-03:20 (p95 812ms -> 1.9s). Noting correlation with KMS call timeouts. Snippet from runtime logs:
```
2026-03-10T02:33:21Z ERROR kvcache: GetEncryptionKey failed: context deadline exceeded
2026-03-10T02:33:21Z WARN request: fallback to unencrypted cache
```
Alex Nguyen (Infra): KMS integration shows rotation job queued on customer KMS side; our HSM logs show successful handshake but intermittent TLS renegotiation failures with the peer CA.
Sam Carter (CSM): Outcome for Northpoint: partial degradation for ~40 mins, then auto-failover to fallback model variant kept most traffic served. No dropped billing events AFAICT, but spend jumped due to retries and higher token utilization.
Martin Lee (Northpoint): Confirmed retries + some customers triggered re-generations. We estimate additional spend ~$1.9k for the week from retries.
Priya Rao (Eng Oncall): Root causes to track: 1) peer VPN appliance rekey handling bug, 2) KMS rotation timing and short timeout windows. Short-term mitigation: extend KMS client timeout and enable aggressive cache TTL for encryption keys.
Alex Nguyen (Infra): I've opened infra ticket INF-4721 to request VPN policy bump and to coordinate with Northpoint's network team. Also enabling 30s extra KMS client timeout for their deployment tonight.
Sam Carter (CSM): Action items — 1) @Alex Nguyen follow up with Northpoint networking (INF-4721) 2) @Priya Rao push KMS timeout change and confirm behavior 3) Sam to schedule enablement call with Northpoint for rotation procedures. Martin, available Thurs 15:00 UTC?
Martin Lee (Northpoint): Thurs 15:00 UTC works. Appreciate the quick responses. Please add our network lead (tara@northpoint.io) to INF ticket.
Priya Rao (Eng Oncall): Added `KMS_TIMEOUT=45s` experiment to canary, will watch for error rate regressions and report back by EOD.
monitoring-bot: DIGEST: seoul region baseline: uptime 99.1%, p50 48ms, p95 1.9s during incident window. Total errors attributed: 42 failed requests. Spend impact flagged.
Sam Carter (CSM): Putting this in the weekly health packet and flagging as renewal risk mitigation item until KMS rotations are validated. Will update renewal playbook with needed network checklist.
Martin Lee (Northpoint): Thanks all — will loop in Tara and confirm the key rotation window. :thumbsup:
Sam Carter (CSM): Closing thread for now, will reopen if EOD checks show residual risk. Summary/action list in INF-4721. :white_check_mark:
